name: Avacyn
description: Avacyn is the archangel of Innistrad, created by Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity, who leads the angels and gives her name to the Church of Avacyn.

summary.text: Avacyn is the archangel of Innistrad, created by Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity, who leads the angels and gives her name to the Church of Avacyn.

bio.text: Sorin created her to protect humans, and Griselbrand later trapped her in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
When the Helvault was sundered she was released, and her return ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
Afterward she appointed servants such as Dovid and sent Vronos to bring Garruk to her cathedral.
Then madness took hold of her, and she turned murderous, killing Kelse and declaring that the great work had begun.
She attacked Nahiri as a planar threat, and later attacked Tamiyo and Jace in Thraben Cathedral, where Jace learned she was the source of the angels' madness but not its origin.
Sorin confronted her there, and she turned on him, condemning him for creating her flawed.
Sorin destroyed her by performing his ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she died with a final prayer.
After her death, Thalia's party met Rem Karolus carrying Avacyn's broken spear, and Thalia told her army Avacyn was gone.

status.text: She is dead, unmade by her creator Sorin, and later stories mention her only as a lost protector and a headless statue.

timeline.summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
timeline.quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

timeline.summary: Vronos returns as a penitent and Avacyn forgives him, accepting his renewed pledge.
timeline.quote: She kissed her maimed servant's brow and spoke words of forgiveness and understanding.

timeline.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
timeline.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

timeline.summary: Flashback: wounded at the battle of Child's Wall, Dovid lies feverish in the cathedral courtyard after Avacyn appears.
timeline.quote: and then a blinding light when, at last, Avacyn appeared.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, with the angel Gryta, summons Dovid and orders him to prepare the forbidden space of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: You, and you alone, must prepare that space previously forbidden.

timeline.summary: Dovid is given Eost, a sword forged from the Helvault, with his name at the top of the honored list.
timeline.quote: I have drawn it only once, during the ceremony where it was presented to me, when Avacyn touched its point.

timeline.summary: Dovid solves the Nightfall Cathars' spell on the journal and learns that Avacyn had been sealed with Griselbrand and that church power diminished, a secret kept from the congregation.
timeline.quote: Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand, and during that time our power had diminished.

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, hearing a mother's panicked prayer, leaves her mountain retreat and flies toward Gavony.
timeline.quote: Avacyn focused on the prayer, on the woman sending it to her, and saw an image of the woman running and sobbing in the middle of a large meadow.

timeline.summary: Avacyn finds the lost boy Maeli huddled in the crook of a tree after lighting up the forest and calling for him.
timeline.quote: Avacyn fixed the location of the child in her mind, and swooped over and down to a spot in the forest a few minutes away.

timeline.summary: Avacyn returns Maeli to his mother Kelse, and feels satisfied that this is why she exists.
timeline.quote: It took only moments for her to find the mother on the outskirts of the trees and give her the child.

timeline.summary: A violent shimmer racks Avacyn, doubling her vision and leaving a constant buzzing in her ears.
timeline.quote: A violent shimmer wracked her body, shaking her vision.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees Kelse turn angry at Maeli and a thought comes to her that mortals are rotten, turning her view of the child from innocence to disgust.
timeline.quote: The seeds of men are rotten.

timeline.summary: Avacyn flees the scene, her mind consumed by the buzzing and the same words repeating.
timeline.quote: Avacyn fled, seeking refuge from her own mind.

timeline.summary: Avacyn descends into the church courtyard before Macher.
timeline.quote: Macher whirled, his mouth agape, and saw an angel descend.

timeline.summary: Avacyn accuses Macher of doubting, mocks his claim to be pure, and asks whether she has lost faith in him.
timeline.quote: You prayed to me because you doubted.

timeline.summary: Terrified, Macher collapses; Avacyn whispers 'Soon' and vanishes, leaving him certain of the true nature of his god.
timeline.quote: He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.

timeline.summary: A winged figure, perhaps Avacyn, blasts the roof off and strikes Liont with a lance of energy.
timeline.quote: She pointed her spear at him, and the tip grew bright, brighter, brighter than the sun overhead, and a lancing energy struck him in the chest, burning away clothes and skin.

timeline.summary: Refusing his plea for mercy, the angel kills Liont.
timeline.quote: and then he died.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lands in Sigarda's solar, her speech slurred, her spear twisted and her eyes flashing black.
timeline.quote: As the thunder subsided, Avacyn landed in the solar.

timeline.summary: Avacyn announces that the great work is soon to begin.
timeline.quote: The great work is soon to be underway.

timeline.summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
timeline.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

timeline.summary: Avacyn argues that humans are as guilty as the monsters angels fight and must be punished.
timeline.quote: For their crimes we have sought to punish and kill.

timeline.summary: Avacyn says Bruna and Gisela have come around to her view, and the two echo her words.
timeline.quote: It took Bruna and Gisela some time to understand as well.

timeline.summary: Avacyn obliterates the stone roof of the solar with a surge of power and departs with Bruna and Gisela.
timeline.quote: A surge of power leapt from the spear, and the roof...vanished.

timeline.summary: Kelse prays to Avacyn for help and finds that Avacyn herself, dressed in black with blood-red wings, is leading the destruction.
timeline.quote: You do not need to pray your lies to me, creature. I'm right here in front of you.

timeline.summary: Avacyn declares the great work has begun and says she will find Maeli eventually.
timeline.quote: I will find the small creature eventually.

timeline.summary: Avacyn kills Kelse with her spear and watches her ashes blow away.
timeline.quote: Avacyn watched as the remains of the mortal creature blew away, the ashes scattering and swirling for a moment of flight before falling to the ground.

timeline.summary: Avacyn hears the sky, rivers, trees and moon whisper a single truth and believes she now listens to truth, not liars.
timeline.quote: All whispered glorious truth.

timeline.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
timeline.quote: Sorin made her.

timeline.summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
timeline.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 643: the cryptoliths warp mana flow, with potentially severe effects on angels.
timeline.quote: The disruptive properties of the stones appear to also extend to an ability to warp the flow of mana through the region

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
timeline.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
timeline.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
timeline.quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

timeline.summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
timeline.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

timeline.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

timeline.summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

timeline.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
timeline.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
timeline.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

timeline.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
timeline.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

timeline.summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
timeline.quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

timeline.summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

timeline.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
timeline.quote: And then she froze.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
timeline.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
timeline.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

timeline.summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
timeline.quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

timeline.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
timeline.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
timeline.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

timeline.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
timeline.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
timeline.quote: I am your creator

timeline.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
timeline.quote: He is the reason I exist.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
timeline.quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

timeline.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
timeline.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

timeline.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
timeline.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
timeline.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

timeline.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
timeline.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
timeline.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

timeline.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
timeline.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

timeline.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
timeline.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
timeline.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils pin Arlinn as she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer.
timeline.quote: She waited, opening herself to the power of the protector; she needed power to save the angel.

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Innistrad, visits graves and confesses in churches and to angels.
timeline.quote: she had visited the graves, Reeves's, Leighton's, all of them.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Rembert that Avacyn is gone and they must find strength in each other.
timeline.quote: We must find strength in each other.

timeline.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
timeline.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

timeline.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

timeline.summary: Maeli prays to Avacyn, who is dead, for help.
timeline.quote: PLEASE, AVACYN! HELP ME!

timeline.summary: Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

timeline.summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
timeline.quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

timeline.summary: Thalia shows her army the spear and tells them Avacyn is gone, urging them to be their own light.
timeline.quote: For the memory of Avacyn, of the light and goodness that have fled from the world, we fight!

timeline.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
timeline.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
timeline.quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

timeline.summary: Thalia's letter, read to Odric, tells of Avacyn's death, the fall of the archangels and a stronger evil that forced Saint Traft out of her.
timeline.quote: She is dead, too.

timeline.summary: Sorin batters Edgar with an iron pipe, but Edgar insists he created Avacyn from his research and has squandered his gift.
timeline.quote: "Your little toy soldier? Yes, I'm aware."

timeline.summary: Sorin, lying in a pit of blood, reflects on Nahiri and Avacyn and his grandfather's betrayal, then drinks the blood to heal.
timeline.quote: They thought this cellar would drown him, but it's only made him stronger.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

timeline.summary: Madness sweeps Innistrad as hope of Avacyn's protection turns to horror.
timeline.quote: Madness swept over Innistrad as the fleeting hope of Avacyn's angelic protection turned to horror.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov intervenes and unmakes Avacyn, his beloved creation, and the plane's last protections fall.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

relations.note: Her forces hunt perpetrators in line with Avacyn's rule.
relations.quote: Sigarda's forces were hunting the perpetrators of the Nephalia Massacre.

relations.note: Vronos is her devoted cathar servant.
relations.quote: He pledged himself anew to her service.

relations.note: Avacyn wants him brought to her cathedral before his curse makes him a demon.
relations.quote: this affliction will transform him into a demon beyond any other

relations.note: According to the journal, Sorin created Avacyn to rally the remaining angels.
relations.quote: Sorin created Avacyn, a force to rally our remaining angels

relations.note: Dovid swears himself her servant.
relations.quote: I am your servant, and your will is mine.

relations.note: Gryta relays Avacyn's instructions.
relations.quote: She will show you the way, and relay our instructions in the days to come.

relations.note: Sealed together in the Helvault.
relations.quote: Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand

relations.note: Werewolves who chose to become her servants.
relations.quote: wolfir, wolven servants of Avacyn

relations.note: According to the journal, Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans.
relations.quote: Sorin Markov made Avacyn.

relations.note: Sorin made her as protector of Innistrad.
relations.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

relations.note: He is Avacyn's creator.
relations.quote: I am your creator

relations.note: He undoes his gift in a reverse ritual.
relations.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

relations.note: Nahiri realizes he made the angel.
relations.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

relations.note: He created Avacyn in Thraben to protect Innistrad.
relations.quote: Thraben was where he had created Avacyn to protect it.

relations.note: Arlinn was formerly an Avacynian priest.
relations.quote: As an Avacynian priest, Arlinn knew well how strong the Archangel's protection had been.

relations.note: Arlinn says Sorin made Avacyn.
relations.quote: "Have you already forgotten why you made her?" she says.

relations.note: Sorin made Avacyn.
relations.quote: And in the days before he made Avacyn

relations.note: Sorin made Avacyn.
relations.quote: "I created Avacyn—"

relations.note: He created and unmade her.
relations.quote: Avacyn, his most treasured creation.

relations.note: Created to safeguard humanity and let it coexist with its predators.
relations.quote: the powerful archangel Avacyn who was created by the Planeswalker Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity

relations.note: He trapped her in the Helvault.
relations.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

relations.note: He unmade her.
relations.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

pages_say.description: The angel who returned and cleansed Innistrad, ending the moon's control over life and death.
The angel of Vronos's faith, freed from the Helvault, who forgives Vronos and sends him to bring Garruk to her cathedral.
The angel who returned to guide humanity and who appoints Dovid as comitant; a journal reveals she was created by Sorin.
The angel whose light the townsfolk believe protects them from werewolves.

A powerful angel, the living embodiment of hope and protection for humans, freed from imprisonment; under the influence of a strange buzzing and whispers she turns murderous and begins the great work.
Innistrad's angel of purity and goodness, who according to the journal was made by Sorin to protect humans; the angels she rules have turned on the people.
Innistrad's angel, whose madness the journal links to the cryptoliths.
The archangel created by Sorin to protect Innistrad, who attacks Nahiri as a planar threat.
Innistrad's archangel, who has turned on her own flock with violence.
The archangel at the head of the church, now leading a purge; Thalia doubts whether the Helvault corrupted her.
The archangel of Innistrad, now mad and bloody-winged, who attacks Tamiyo and Jace and is the source of the angels' madness though not its origin.
The mad archangel of Innistrad, created by Sorin as protector, who attacks Jace and Tamiyo, learns the truth of her creation, turns on Sorin and is destroyed by him.
The archangel of Innistrad, fallen and destroyed, whose blessing Arlinn once hoped would cure her.
An angel with white hair and dark eyes made by Sorin as his enforcer; this page does not name her.
The dead archangel whom Maeli prays to.
The archangel Olivia reports dead.
The angel Sorin created who is dead, whom Nahiri mocks.
The dead archangel whose broken spear Thalia carries.
An angel whose last words to her creator, that what cannot be destroyed must be bound, Jace remembers; he also compares Emeria's height to hers.
The archangel whose protection fell during the Travails and whose symbol still hangs in Kessig homes.
The angel whose holy symbols the people of Kessig keep in their homes and churches.
The angel Sorin created, who can no longer hear prayers; her headless statue holds the key.
The angel who slew Liesa; churches were raised in her name.
The angel Adeline hopes a trace of is left in Sorin; her eventual fall is wondered about.
The archangel who is dead; her tears kept above the chapel altar are meant for the demon's anointing.
The angel Sorin made to solve the vampire problem, who perished.
The angel Sorin created, which Edgar calls his toy soldier.
The absent angel whose blessed symbols still frighten Strefan a little.
The angel Sorin created and later unmade.
An angel the innkeeper thanks for watching over the survivors.
A powerful archangel created by Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity; she is trapped in the Helvault, released, then driven mad and unmade.
